messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that either falls on a weekday adjacent to a weekend or is observed on a weekday because the actual holiday fell on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Sunday Jan 1 → observed Monday Jan 2; the weekend + Monday makes a 3‑day break. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, SK) | Family Day was on Monday Feb 20; the preceding weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Apr 7–8** | Good Friday | Good Friday itself is a holiday; the following Saturday/Sunday completes the long weekend. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday May 22; the preceding weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1; it was observed on Monday Jul 3, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Aug 31–Sep 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday Sep 4; the preceding weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday Oct 9; the preceding weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas Day was on Monday Dec 25; the preceding weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **Dec 25–27** | Boxing Day (observed Dec 27) | Boxing Day fell on Tuesday Dec 26; it was observed on Wednesday Dec 27. Combined with Christmas, it creates a 4‑day stretch from Dec 23–27. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** Some provinces have extra holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific data, you’ll want to pull the full holiday schedule for each jurisdiction.

Feel free to copy/paste the table into your holiday‑planning app!
